description: This Java class defines a global exception handler for a Spring Boot application. It captures all unhandled exceptions, logs them, and returns a standardized negative response object. The class uses annotations for Spring's exception handling mechanisms and leverages Lombok for logging.

classes.name: GlobalExceptionHandler
classes.description: A Spring Boot REST controller advice that handles all unhandled exceptions globally and returns a standardized error response.

methods.name: handleException
methods.description: Handles any Throwable not caught elsewhere, logs it, and returns a NegativeResponse with internal server error status.

methods.name: handleDefault
methods.description: Creates and logs a default error response for the provided throwable, extracting its message or defaulting if null.
